# file: myapp/_bindings.py
def _ffi_validate_amount(amount: float) -> bool:
    return amount > 0


# file: myapp/orders/service.py
from myapp._bindings import _ffi_validate_amount


def create_order(amount: float) -> bool:
    return _ffi_validate_amount(amount)


# file: myapp/payments/service.py
from myapp._bindings import _ffi_validate_amount


def process_payment(amount: float) -> bool:
    return _ffi_validate_amount(amount)
